description: Single on-chain transaction with category enum + amount + counterparty DID + supporting CID. G12 STRUCTURAL: category enum DELIBERATELY excludes 'payroll' / 'wage' / 'salary' / 'bonus' / 'commission' values — volunteer ≠ employee per Liberation Ladder L0..L6 (ADR-2605261000 + ADR-2605262700 G13). Constructive-employment drift prevented at schema layer.

txCid.description: On-chain transaction hash / CID (Base L2 or geth-private chain depending on origin).

category.description: G12 INVARIANT: 'payroll' / 'wage' / 'salary' / 'bonus' / 'commission' are NOT valid values. Volunteer ≠ employee structural enforcement.

counterpartyDid.description: Counterparty DID (donor / grantee / vendor / steward; pseudonymous DID acceptable)

linkedAttestationCid.description: Cross-link to source attestation (e.g., chigiri.stewardLaborAttestation for subsistence flow / chigiri.ipLicenseClaim for external counsel)

supportingDocumentCid.description: Supporting document CID (encrypted per ADR-2605181100 if PII present)
